_comment: Remote Input module messages — Controller <-> Gateway <-> Agent
_fire_and_forget_note: input_mouse_move uses Fire-and-Forget strategy. Agent does NOT send an ACK response for mouse_move unless an error occurs (e.g. missing parameters), preventing network flood at 60+ events/sec. Controller must not wait for ACK on move events.
_consent_note: Remote Input is gated by its OWN feature = "input" (NOT "screen"). Controller must send permission_request { feature: "input" } and wait for permission_result { granted: true } before emitting any input_* command. On grant the Agent shows a distinct visual indicator (blue 'K' overlay, top-left corner) and emits input_started. On revoke / stop_module / socket drop the Agent emits input_stopped.

input_mouse_move._desc: Move mouse cursor to absolute screen coordinates (pixels on primary screen). NOTE: Fire-and-Forget (Agent does NOT send ACK for move).

input_key._desc: Simulate keyboard key event by Virtual Key code (vk: integer VK code, action: 'down'|'up'|'press')

input_type._desc: Type text string via SendInput UNICODE

input_result._desc: Agent returns execution result for mouse click, key, or type commands

input_result_error._desc: Agent returns failure status if parameters are invalid or execution fails

input_started._desc: Agent user granted the "input" consent popup. The Agent has shown the blue 'K' overlay (top-left) and is now ready to receive input_* commands. Emitted from AgentClient after permission_result{granted:true, feature:"input"}.

input_stopped._desc: Agent hid the input overlay and will drop any further input_* commands. Emitted on permission_revoke{feature:"input"}, stop_module{feature:"input"}, or on socket drop (OnDisconnected).

input_denied._desc: Agent user rejected the "input" consent popup (or 30 s timeout). Controller should surface a toast and keep the Remote Input UI disabled.
